config.notes: Monash course pages www.monash.edu/study/course/<CODE>?international=true (international view). Course Details block: "Location ... Duration ... Start date First semester (February) and Second semester (July) Qualification"; Monash College pages print "Intakes February, June and October Study area". Fee: "International fee: Fees are per 48 credit points (a standard full-time year). The fees for 2027 are: A$NN,NNN"; 24 credit point courses print a course total then "The equivalent fee per 48 credit points ... would be A$NN,NNN" (the annual figure is read, never the total). Domestic "Full fee"/CSP blocks are not read. IELTS: "IELTS (Academic) : 6.5 Overall" (graduate) or the English tests table (undergraduate). No term_months: course pages print the month next to each semester and some differ (M6012 Second Semester = June). Handbook pages (handbook.monash.edu, pubs/*handbooks) carry no international fee or intakes. Central English: https://www.monash.edu/admissions/entry-requirements/english-language (IELTS 6.5, no band below 6.0; some courses higher). Key dates: https://www.monash.edu/study-abroad/inbound/apply/key-dates Delivery (mode): read from the international-view Course Details "Location" panel, each delivery label printed before a study-load line ("On-campus at <campus>: Full time", "Online: Full time & part time", "Multi-modal at <campus>: Full time"); Monash College pages print "<campus> on campus ... Entry Requirements". All labels are kept (pick all). Notes such as "cannot be completed online" are not read. International view (5 Oct 13:02): page_view renders www.monash.edu/study/course/<CODE>?international=true through Firecrawl (url_pattern names only those pages); find-a-course pages without international=true are the domestic view and are not read for fees. Some international-view pages print no year: "International fee Fees are per 48 credit points which represents a standard full-time course load for a year. A$NN,NNN" (read as the annual fee, year not printed).
